notes.title: Entities Update v1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Thank you for supporting and playing Entities. We are happy to announce this year's Halloween update, filled with exciting new features, changes, and fixes, as well as a brand-new trailer![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/235520d6de1d5534e01f5a82125b572123996e70.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/26e24d6d435c1ebf737a4fa2e22303db2d381cd8.jpg[/img]

[h3]Changes and Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed online sessions issues

[*] Fixed connectivity issues

[*] Fixed minor UI bugs

[*] Fixed AI navigation issues

[*] Fixed character-related bugs

[*] Balanced stats for all entities

[*] Increased mission rewards rates

[*] Adjusted item prices in the shop

[*] Increased perk point gain

[*] Compressed game file size

[*] Updated loot table

[*] Entities drop more loot on death
[/list]

[h3]New Content & Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added difficulty select to Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes

[*] Added the ability to sprint for a short distance

[*] Introduced a stamina system

[*] Improved weapon animations

[*] Added a new mission for Halloween: Nature Reserve

[*] Added a new enemy type: Deadly Insect

[*] Improved player movement system

[*] Improved player camera system
[/list]

[b]We want to wish you all a great holiday! Thank you again for playing Entities.[/b]

notes.title: Entities hotfix v1.2.1
notes.notes: This hotfix addresses a few bugs and issues, and also includes some balancing adjustments.

notes.title: Entities update v1.2
notes.notes:
[b]We wanted to extend our deepest gratitude for your unwavering support, invaluable feedback, and fantastic suggestions. and we're thrilled to present an update aimed at making the experience better.[/b]


[h2]New Features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Perk System:[/b] Customize your playstyle with the initial iteration of the perk system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/d4ca818e1c04b16f386e356b0c793583dd80f566.png[/img]

[*] [b]Character Customization:[/b] Select a new suit for your operator.

[*] [b]S12 Shotgun:[/b] Introducing a brand-new firearm, the S12 shotgun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/d53e504276b5090731c4cd8e73a8d1610ebf2c02.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]New Enemy Type & Enemies:[/b] Encounter fresh challenges with a new enemy type and several new foes to test your skills.

[*] [b]New Mission - Area 09 Museum:[/b] Explore a thrilling new mission that promises intrigue and excitement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/543e7b97bf859b9257788bcf0958e31f2e7cc72f.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Visual Bugs:[/b] Addressed minor visual inconsistencies for a smoother experience.

[*] [b]Menu and UI Performance:[/b] Optimized performance.

[*] [b]Mission Fixes:[/b] Squashed bugs in specific missions for a more consistent gameplay flow.

[*] [b]Pathfinding and AI Tweaks:[/b] Enhanced pathways and AI navigation.

[*] [b]Leaderboard Load Time:[/b] Fixed issues to ensure swift leaderboard access.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your adventure in Entities awaits![/b]

notes.title: Entities Hotfix v1.1.1
notes.notes:
[b]We express our sincere appreciation for your support, feedback, and bug reporting. Your active engagement is pivotal to the continual refinement of Entities.

In this hotfix, our focus has been on rectifying identified issues.

Rest assured that your feedback is integral to our ongoing efforts to augment the experience. Concurrently, we are diligently crafting additional progression features and compelling content for an update scheduled for the coming week.[/b]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/8eb65b4ffe5b22dbe82077bac826df81b3aa2ef5.png[/img]

notes.title: Entities Update Version 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]We want to express our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you for your unwavering support, valuable feedback, bug reports, and fantastic suggestions. We're thrilled to present the latest update that marks the beginning of a new era for the game.[/b]

[h2]Bug Fixes and Changes:[/h2]

[b]In our ongoing commitment to enhance the experience, we've addressed several issues in this update:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed some paths and areas where enemies would get stuck.

[*] Resolved instances of players getting stuck in certain places.

[*] Rectified player visual bugs for a smoother experience.

[*] Updated and optimized various UI elements.

[*] Fixed the in-game chat system.

[*] Tweaked and balanced the loot pool.

[*] Implemented improvements to the matchmaking system.

[*] Health regen is now exclusive to Survival missions.
[/list]

[h2]New features & Content:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added equip animations for all weapons, adding a touch of realism.

[*] Added Interaction Animation.

[*] Added Server Browser.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/c2552812dc864f73e3e6fc44dad9b79367654dbf.jpg[/img]

[*] Added Latest News to main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/60fae8e9155b75dfefd12bdca8c335646811d164.jpg[/img]

[*] Added two new missions to challenge your skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/d01c7994f69234a545a202fa56ca57f20eeb6eb0.jpg[/img]

[*] Added the ability to barricade certain doorways and paths.

[*] Added the ability to throw the Flare to blind enemies for a very short duration.

[*] Added "Stun Grenade"  a tactical addition to stun enemies for a short duration.

[*] Added the ability to find planks to build barricades and fortify your defenses.

[*] Added the ability to find Bitcoin a valuable in game currency.

[*] Added  Sell feature in the armory.

[*] Added a new enemy type that explodes upon being shot, posing a threat to players in proximity.
[/list]


[b]This update marks the beginning of shaping the future of Entities, with more exciting updates on the horizon. We value your input and are committed to making Entities the best it can be.

Thank you for being part of this incredible journey. We wish you a fantastic weekend![/b]

notes.title: Entities v1.03 Hotfix
notes.notes: [b]This update focuses on addressing various visual bugs, ensuring a smoother gameplay. We've also addressed a few issues with the leaderboard system. and we are happy to announce the addition of our first Steam achievements.[/b]

notes.title: Entities Weekend Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Wishing you all a fantastic weekend! We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your unwavering support. Your enthusiasm keeps us going![/b]

[b]In this small update, we've focused on enhancing the experience with some improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Disable Blackout Effect:[/b] You now have the option to disable the Blackout effect when under attack.

[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] We've resolved minor bugs, including the reload cancel issue, allowing for fair gameplay. Also, switching guns while reloading will no longer cause the newly equipped gun to reload.

[*] [b]Controller Support:[/b] We're thrilled to introduce the first phase of Controller Support. Get ready to immerse yourself in the game with your preferred gaming setup!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/46ee3a932052894c5a98bc4f90dff798c740f4b6.png[/img]

[*] [b]Leaderboard System:[/b] Exciting times ahead! We've implemented the initial version of our Leaderboard system. Compete, climb the ranks, and showcase your skills to the community.
[/list]

[b]Thank you for being a part of our community. Have a fantastic weekend![/b]

notes.title: Entities Hotfix 1.02
notes.notes:
[b]We extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of you who have dedicated your time to reporting bugs and sharing invaluable feedback and suggestions. Your contributions are instrumental in enhancing the experience for everyone.

Our mission has always been to ensure your utmost satisfaction, and with your support, we continue to strive for perfection. We are delighted to announce a new hotfix that brings several improvements to the game, making Entities better:[/b]

[h2]Hotfix Highlights:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Camera Shake Toggle:[/b] Newly added option to disable Camera Shake in the graphic settings.

[*] [b]Body Cam Effect:[/b] Immerse yourself further into the action by enabling the Body Cam Effect in the graphic settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/688537353f762c766b110b122f5da7ba1eda0cce.png[/img]

[*] [b]Multiplayer Mission Select Info:[/b] The addition of detailed mission select information in multiplayer mode.

[*] [b]Mobs Stats Tweaks:[/b] We've tweaked and balanced the stats of all mobs.

[*] [b]Payment Distribution Fix:[/b] No more disparities in rewards. We've resolved the bug where only the host was receiving the payment, ensuring that everyone gets their rightful share for their efforts.

[*] [b]Equipment Spawn Fix:[/b] Invited players will now always spawn with their equipment as intended, 

[*] [b]Inventory Display Fix:[/b] Bid farewell to confusion. The bug causing the inventory to sometimes display empty after leaving a lobby has been rectified. Your items will always be accounted for.

[*] [b]Respawn Improvement:[/b] Fixed a bug for some enemies that would get stuck at Afula Zone C.
[/list]

[b]Thank you once again for your invaluable support.

Happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix!
notes.notes: [b]We've rolled out a Day 1 Hotfix to address some visual glitches and reported bugs. Thank you for contributing![/b]

notes.title: Early Access Entities Release Right Around the Corner!
notes.notes:
[h2]Entities Arrives This Halloween! [/h2]

[b]We are overwhelmed with gratitude as we eagerly announce that the highly anticipated Early Access release of Entities is just on the horizon! We extend our heartfelt thanks to every player who has shown interest in our game, to those who explored the DEMO, to the vibrant community that emerged on the Entities Discord, and to the dedicated souls who shared their invaluable feedback, suggestions, and bug reports. Your enthusiasm and support have fueled our journey, and we couldn’t be more thankful![/b]


[h2]Fooster & Fisk[/h2]
[b]A huge shoutout to Fooster and Fisk for crafting the most phenomenal video for Entities, their creativity knows no bounds, and we are indebted to them for capturing the essence of our game so beautifully.[/b]

[previewyoutube=6KOHVljM0-c;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]The Future of Entities![/h2]
[b]But the excitement doesn’t end here, we have grand plans in store for Entities, shaping it into an immersive experience that will keep you engaged for countless hours. What are our plans? This is our vision, and this is what possibly can be added![/b]

[list]
[*] [b]More Horror:[/b] As we delve deeper into the realms of horror and psychological suspense, rest assured that Entities will keep you on the edge of your seat, thoroughly terrified.

[*] [b]Massive Loot Tables:[/b] Discover an abundance of new items, weapons, and equipment, each more exciting than the last.

[*] [b]Player Market:[/b] Engage in lively trading sessions with fellow players, exchanging items.

[*] [b]Player Customization:[/b] Transform your appearance to reflect your unique style.

[*] [b]Global Leaderboard:[/b] Climb to the top and become the most skilled operator in the world, showcasing your prowess to all.

[*] [b]PvP Mode:[/b] Join intense battles with both Entities and players, survive, and claim the spoils of victory (Possibly!).

[*] [b]Real-Time Global Events:[/b] Dive into events that unfold in real-time, requiring cooperation with players.

[*] [b]Immersion:[/b] Immerse yourself in a world brought to life with animations for every interaction, more physical interactions, advanced physics, and destruction.

[*] [b]Better Optimization:[/b] Experience smoother gameplay with each update as we continuously tweak and enhance performance.

[*] [b]New Mechanics:[/b] Explore fresh puzzles, systems, and gameplay mechanics that will challenge your skills and creativity.

[*] [b]Entities:[/b] Encounter new enemy types, each with unique abilities and weaknesses, adding depth to your strategic encounters.

[*] [b]Community-Driven Development:[/b] We are dedicated to listening to your suggestions and feedback, incorporating your ideas into the game's future updates.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44588817/7c9ec98365da1b159ae2836379b01fb31d6da78f.png[/img]

[b]Thank you for being a part of this incredible community. We can’t wait to see you in the world of Entities.[/b]
